interpretations: For each rental, sum the amounts of payments linked to it and assign it to the store holding its inventory copy. Compute one overall average of the nonmissing rental totals across both stores. For each store, include only rentals whose total strictly exceeds that average, and report the store ID, the sum of their rental totals, and their average excess over the overall average, without rounding.
queries:
WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total
  FROM rental_totals
)
SELECT
  rt.store_id,
  SUM(rt.total) AS total_amount,
  AVG(rt.total - o.avg_total) AS average_excess
FROM rental_totals AS rt
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE rt.total > o.avg_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id
